**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What the document has:** § 5.1 warrants Services will be performed "using reasonable care and skill" with qualified personnel, plus authority and a compliance-with-laws covenant. § 5.2 makes those the exclusive warranties; § 5.4 disclaims uninterrupted/error-free operation, capacity/performance, and provides **all Materials "AS IS"**.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** no conformance warranty for Deliverables/Materials, no warranty period, and no remedy anywhere (no re-performance/repair/refund, no SLA or credits). The § 5.4(c) "AS IS" for all Materials swallows any deliverable-level assurance, pushing toward walk-away territory.
- **Redline (validated ok:true), pitched at the fallback:** new § 5.1(c) adding a 90-day conformance warranty for Deliverables/Materials plus no-malicious-code, with an at-IBM's-option re-perform/repair/refund remedy; and an "Except as expressly warranted in Section 5.1" carve-out at the head of § 5.4(c).
